name: laws_dev_v1
notes: 20 natural-language questions written by the project team and labelled with the PDF page(s) containing the answer. This set was used for error analysis and to develop the query-expansion map, so it is a DEVELOPMENT set: metrics on it are optimistic, not unbiased held-out performance. Page labels are coarse (a query is a hit if any retrieved chunk lies on a labelled page; the page may contain other material too). Page 111 is a figure-only page; its handball answer is also labelled on page 110, which is indexed.
page_label_basis: 1-based PDF page index of 'Laws of the Game 2025_26_single pages.pdf' (== printed page number).
